description: This PHP class 'EmailSubscriptionService' provides a service layer for managing email subscriptions within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It encapsulates the data access object (DAO) 'EmailSubscriptionDao' and provides a getter method to initialize and retrieve this DAO.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionService
classes.description: Provides a service layer for email subscription management, encapsulating the DAO and offering a getter method to access it.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmailSubscriptionDao, initializing it if it has not been created yet.
